source_snapshot.procedure: 1 s Off→On; observe 2 Hz/0.5 Hz green; 1 s in OS graceful shutdown; 4 s forced off.
source_snapshot.criteria: Repeats these, but item 7 says an On node remains On after one press.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH with separate graceful and forced-off checkpoints.

old_problem: The same apparent On-state single press must both gracefully shut down (Procedure 4/Criteria 6) and remain On (Criteria 7). No node-target or ACPI-policy distinction resolves this; long-hold force-off also needs destructive safeguards.
disposition_reason: This is an explicit source conflict, not a missing runtime identifier. ED-19 preserves all criteria and ED-15 forbids choosing a convenient PASS oracle. Engineering must distinguish multi-node targeting or OS ACPI policy before the manual power-button matrix can be judged.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2264 and 2265, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve Off→On short press, 2 Hz/0.5 Hz green startup states, OS boot, On-state short press, >4-second forced off and criterion 7.
Separate every state/action with monotonic timing, physical video and OS/BMC/ACPI/SEL corroboration.
Require exact node/button/LED mapping and engineering resolution of shutdown versus remain-On behavior.
Forced off is a distinct one-shot destructive checkpoint after workload/storage drain and recovery readiness; never a retry path.
No physical press, power transition, shutdown, force-off, log clearing or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Manual power-button state matrix with unresolved On-short-press conflict
test_case.purpose: Verify physical power-on, startup LED cadence, policy-defined short-press behavior and separately authorized long-hold forced off across exact node states, without discarding the contradictory criterion.
required_package: Button/LED/node mapping and initial/final state matrix
Owner resolution of On-state short press versus criterion 7
test_case.test_command: Gate the contradictory checkpoint. A qualified operator performs each measured press separately with SUT-linked video: 1 s from Off, observe startup LED/OS Ready; apply the approved On-state 1 s policy; after recovery and separate authorization, hold >4 s for forced off; collect synchronized OS/BMC/ACPI/SEL and restore final state.
test_case.expected_result: Off-state short press powers the mapped node and produces approved 2 Hz then 0.5 Hz green phases through OS Ready; On-state short press follows the explicitly resolved policy/node scope; long hold forces only the target off; all stages recover to the signed final state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires engineering's noncontradictory short-press oracle and separate complete evidence for every checkpoint. Until then the decision remains Pending. Wrong node, cadence, shutdown behavior, forced-off boundary, storage/boot damage or failed recovery is FAIL after the oracle exists.
safety_gate: Qualified physical operator and exact node/button map.
Dedicated drained node with console and storage recovery.
Short and long presses are isolated; long hold separately approved.
Stop on unexpected shutdown, stuck button, boot/storage/log fault; no retry.
expected_evidence: Measured press/video and 2 Hz/0.5 Hz optical analysis
OS Ready and short-press ACPI/shutdown or no-change evidence
test_case.recovery: On any unexpected power effect, stop further presses, preserve console/SEL/video/storage evidence and use only the approved independent recovery; never long-hold or repeat to recover.

source_conflict.reason: Graceful shutdown and remain-On are mutually exclusive for the same apparent single On-state press absent a node/policy distinction.

blocked.reason: Non-conflicting checkpoints are defined; owner disposition can unlock the short-press oracle.
